## About
Dipson Air Conditioning is a family owned and operated business based in Richardson, right in the center of the DFW area. Dipson Dam started the company to give his neighbors a fast, honest, reliable option for their heating, cooling and refrigeration needs.
Dipson still runs the service calls himself, so the person you speak with on the phone is the person who shows up. He is a Trane and Rheem dealer but works on every brand of equipment.
We take care of homes and small businesses alike, from the air conditioner at your house to the coolers at your restaurant. Our Google rating sits at 4.8 from 56 reviews.

## Services
- Air conditioning installations and repairs: Installing a new unit or repairing the one you have.
- Heating system installations and repairs: Installing and repairing heating systems so you aren't stuck in the cold.
- Commercial HVAC: Installations, air conditioning repairs and preventative maintenance for small businesses, so your employees and customers stay comfortable.
- Commercial refrigeration: Service for restaurant equipment like ice machines, food prep coolers and beverage coolers. We work on all refrigeration brands and models.

## FAQ
Q: Do you work on brands other than Trane and Rheem?
A: Yes. Dipson is a Trane and Rheem dealer but works on every brand of equipment, and on all refrigeration brands and models.

Q: How quickly can you come out?
A: We offer same-day or next-day care for our heating and AC services. Give us a call if you notice anything unusual or broken.

Q: What areas do you serve?
A: We are based in Richardson and serve neighbors in Plano, Garland, Dallas, McKinney, Frisco, Allen, Mesquite, Lewisville and Irving.
